title: Localization of T to finite-mass integer multiplicity pieces on ℝ^P
statement: Assume SlicingTheorem (Simon §4, frozen statement). Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and T ∈ D_{m+1}(U) integer multiplicity with M_W(∂T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U. Then for every x₀ ∈ U there are r > 0 with B_r(x₀) ⊆ U and an integer multiplicity current X ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞, and X(η) = T(η) for every η ∈ D^{m+1}(U) with tsupport η ⊆ B_r(x₀) (η regarded as a test form on ℝ^P via testFormOnInclusion).
lean_statement: SlicingTheorem → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ x₀ ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball x₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity X ∧ X.mass < ∞ ∧ X.boundary.mass < ∞ ∧ ∀ η : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball x₀ r → X (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) (m + 1) η) = T η
